question: The condition of warm days and cold nights are characteristics of which weather and region of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Winters of northern India**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The northern part of India experiences** warm days and cold nights during the winter season**.
 
• The winter season in northern India** usually begins in mid-November and ends by late February**.
 
• The average temperature varies from **22 ºC to 5º C during the winter season**.
 
• This season is suitable for the rabi form of crops which mainly includes **wheat, barley, oats, gram, and mustard**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Summer season in southern India reaches its peak in the **Month of March and April**.
 
• The temperature there lies **between ****40-45°C**.
 
• Days are dry and hot but the nights are comparatively cooler during the summer season in south India.
 
• The coastal regions **remain cool in summer and hot in winter** due to the presence of water near them which forms a moderate type of climate in coastal regions.
